title: How Life Thrives Without Sunlight - Deep Ocean Chemosynthesis
description:
Along the ocean floor, hydrothermal vents spew mineral-dense fluids at over 400 degrees Celsius.

In this pitch-black abyss, specialized bacteria perform chemosynthesis, converting toxic hydrogen sulfide into organic energy without a single ray of sunlight. This chemical engine powers an entire deep-sea food web.
